notes: Kohl's Home (kohls.com) - Clearance investigation. ACCESS: same tier progression as bs196.json/na196.json - tier1 curl_cffi got sitemaps but only Akamai behavioral-challenge shells for catalog pages; tier2 plain Playwright chromium hard 403'd; tier3 Claude-in-Chrome (real connected browser) cleared the behavioral challenge after ~6-8s per fresh nav and rendered real content, used for every page below. robots.txt (live, no Claude-specific disallow) checked first. SCOPE: Kohl's 'Clearance' is a real, permanent Promotions:Clearance facet (confirmed via sitemap - thousands of clearance-*.jsp URLs exist combining this facet with almost every Department/Category), not a temporary seasonal campaign, so it clearly passes the Clearance-vs-Sale test. NAVIGATION: grepped all 6 sitemap_catalog_N.xml for Promotions:Clearance combined with Home-relevant Department/Category values; the sitemap only exposed a bare Department:Home Decor clearance page directly (no bare Furniture/Kitchen&Dining/Lighting Department-level clearance URLs were present in the curated sitemap). Loading catalog.jsp?CN=Activity:For the Home+Promotions:Clearance live revealed this is itself a genuine site-authored hub page (breadcrumb 'Clearance: Home', title 'Home Clearance') that lists no products of its own but links to real per-department Clearance children: Kitchen & Dining, Home Decor, Bed & Bath, Pet Supplies, Closeouts - recorded as a grouping row. Of those children, Pet Supplies was excluded (a separate department/project scope, not home furnishing) and Closeouts was excluded (it is a different Assortment:Closeout Deals facet, not the Clearance promotion, and not Home-specific). Furniture and Lighting were not linked from this hub but were confirmed to independently exist via direct Promotions:Clearance+Department:<X> facet construction (Furniture=1 item, kept; Lighting=0 items, dropped per the zero-listing rule). All qty values below are the site's own on-page 'Show N Items'/heading count, read directly off the rendered PLP after the Akamai challenge cleared - no estimation. Each of these department-level clearance pages also displayed a 'Best Sellers' recommendation carousel (duplicate content across pages) - not treated as a Clearance row, and not a Bestsellers PLP either (see bs196.json).
